fact: Angop reports the RGPH 2024 enumeration began on 19 September 2024 and ended on 19 November 2024, counting 36,604,681 residents.
INE released the definitive RGPH 2024 results on 20 November 2025, per Angop.
INE states it carried out the RGPH nationwide in 2024, reference date 19 September 2024, with collection extended to 20 December 2024.
INE published the definitive RGPH 2024 results report in November 2025.
Angop reports INE counted 8,665,510 people in Luanda province in the RGPH 2024; the document gives no enumeration date beyond 2024.
INE presented the definitive RGPH 2024 results for Luanda province on 24 February 2026, closing the national exercise.
Angop reports INE said the national definitive results of Censo 2024 were presented on 20 November 2025, with provincial presentations from 28 January to 24 February 2026.
INE states the RGPH 2024 was enumerated nationwide from 19 September to 20 December 2024 (census moment 19 September), using 79,423 field agents.
INE states the definitive national results of the RGPH 2024 were published on 20 November 2025, and this Icolo e Bengo provincial report followed.

INE Angola states the RGPH 2024 population count was carried out with reference date 19 September 2024, counting 36,604,681 residents; it was the first digital census, and the previous census was in 2014.
INE Angola states it released the definitive results of Census 2024 (RGPH 2024) on 20 November 2025, ten months after the end of mass data collection and six months after the coverage survey.
